Open-source notices for the physics files in this folder
=====================================================

physx-js-webidl.wasm and physx-js-webidl.mjs are the build of physx-js-webidl 2.9.1 (npm: physx-js-webidl), which contains
NVIDIA PhysX SDK version 5.12.0 (the version the engine reports about itself as PHYSICS_VERSION) compiled to WebAssembly. They are used here,
to simulate the rigid bodies on the home page's lake (Ultra effects only).
The .wasm file is byte-for-byte the one in the npm package; the .mjs JavaScript glue is the package's file minified (esbuild 0.25.12, see PROVENANCE.json), with no other change.
This site is not made, endorsed or sponsored by NVIDIA.
